messages:
maya: Heads up — blackbox probes for inference endpoints in northeast1 are flapping for streaming & embeddings. Started ~10:09 UTC. Getting 524s and 502s. Might be probe overload + cross-region fallbacks.
andre: Saw the ops-bot alerts. 95th latency spike to ~2.2s for streaming; embeddings p95 ~1.4s. Is the NE1 dedicated GPU pool in autoscale cooldown?
ops-bot: ALERT: BLACKBOX_HIGH_LATENCY | region=northeast1 | job=blackbox | p95_streaming=2.2s | p95_embeddings=1.4s | triggered_at=2026-03-17T10:09:45Z
liam: I think probes are too aggressive — current config spawns 50 concurrent probes every 30s for NE1. That creates contention on small pools. Suggest drop concurrency to 5 and interval to 60s for NE1.
sara: Agree. Also our blackbox checks don't wait for KV/cache warmup. Synthetic clients should do a short warm-up request to warm prefixes before measuring streaming p95. For embeddings, add a quality assertion (cosine similarity).
maya: Quick proposal for blackbox module (warmup + tagging):
```yaml
modules:
  http_inference_warmup:
    prober: http
    timeout: 15s
    http:
      valid_http_versions: ["HTTP/2.0"]
      preferred_ip_protocol: "ip4"
      headers:
        "User-Agent": "redwood-synthetic/1.0"
        "X-Probe-Type": "embedding-warmup"
        "X-Probe-Region": "northeast1"
      body: "{{ __random_string 64 }}"
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
```
liam: Also propose Prometheus alert tweak (promql):
```yaml
alert: HighBlackboxLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(blackbox_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"blackbox\",probe_type=~\"stream|embed\"}[5m])) by (le, instance)) > 1.2
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/blackbox-latency
# For NE1 override threshold -> 2.0s while autoscale stabilizes
```
andre: We should label probes with probe_region and probe_role so we can filter synthetic traffic out of customer SLOs and chargeback. Also add header X-Probe-Client so logs can strip it out in cost calc.
sara: On Grafana: I'll add a "blackbox p95 by region" panel and a variable for probe_user header. Also adding a panel correlating probe QPS vs dedicated GPU pool util (panel id: 223).
maya: Temp mitigation: disable high-concurrency probes for northeast1, reduce probe QPS, and update routing: prefer local quantized model variant before cross-region fallback to avoid cold-starts crossing regions.
liam: Opening PR to reduce concurrency + add warmup + tag synthetic: https://git.internal/redwood/configs/pulls/4823 (small change, tests pass).
ops-bot: PR merged by liam — config/blackbox/northeast1.yml (sha: a1b2c3d)
sara: I'll schedule a 10m check-in after stabilization and create a synthetic embedding quality check: run toy prompt -> embedding -> verify cosine_sim(embedding, golden)=0.95+. Will add an alert if quality drops.
maya: Important cost note — probes at 50 QPS * ~8k tokens/session is non-trivial. Cap synthetic to 10rps per region and add budget flag so each region's probe pool is bounded.
liam: Also adding a small client-side jitter and exponential backoff on failures so probes don't storm during autoscale/inflight rollouts.
maya: :thumbsup: thanks team. If NE1 keeps flapping we'll open an incident and backfill capacity. For now we'll watch p95 and PR #4823.
maya: closing thread, will follow up in the all-hands if repeated.
